title: LoCoJAX: Host-Local Coordination for Small-Model RL on TPUs
abstract: arXiv:2611.16301v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) increasingly targets small language models, and executing these workloads efficiently across multiple accelerators requires effective coordination. On TPUs, Pathways-based RL uses a single controller to coordinate computation across hosts. This execution model is effective for large models, but its coordination computational costs are harder to amortize when small models repeatedly invoke short computations. To characterize these computational costs, we sweep dense models from 0.6B to 405B parameters on TPU v7x under a decode-heavy workload and measure how host and network computational overhead vary with model size. At 0.6B, host orchestration occupies 36% of step time and network communication 2%, whereas for large models, estimated network computational costs dominate the non-compute time. Motivated by these findings, we present Local Coordination JAX (LoCoJAX), which implements local rollout and reward

translated_title: LoCoJAX：面向TPU上小模型强化学习的主机本地协调
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）越来越多地针对小型语言模型，而在多个加速器上高效执行这些工作负载需要有效的协调。在TPU上，基于Pathways的强化学习使用单一控制器来协调跨主机的计算。这种执行模型对大模型非常有效，但当小模型反复调用短计算时，其协调计算成本更难摊销。为了表征这些计算成本，我们在TPU v7x上以解码为主的工作负载下，对参数量从0.6B到405B的稠密模型进行了扫描，并测量主机和网络计算开销如何随模型规模变化。在0.6B规模下，主机编排占步骤时间的36%，网络通信占2%；而对于大模型，估计的网络计算成本则主导了非计算时间。基于这些发现，我们提出了本地协调JAX（LoCoJAX），它实现了本地化的rollout和奖励计算
tldr: 该论文发现单一控制器协调模式在小模型强化学习中开销占比过高（0.6B模型下主机编排占步骤时间36%），并提出LoCoJAX通过主机本地执行rollout和奖励计算来提升TPU上小模型RL的效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LoCoJAX, a host-local coordination approach that mitigates the coordination overhead of single-controller Pathways-based execution—where host orchestration occupies 36% of step time for 0.6B models—to improve the efficiency of small-model RL on TPUs.
